claims.claim_text: We characterize the approaches by average distance travelled between infractions of the following five types: Opposite lane, Sidewalk, Collision with static object, Collision with car, Collision with pedestrian.
claims.normalized_text: Approaches are characterized by average distance between five types of infractions.
claims.source_quote: We characterize the approaches by average distance travelled between infractions of the following five types: • Opposite lane: More than 30% of the car’s footprint is over wrong-way lanes. • Sidewalk: More than 30% of the car’s footprint is over the sidewalk. • Collision with static object: Car makes contact with a static object, such as pole or building. • Collision with car: Car makes contact with another car. • Collision with pedestrian: Car makes contact with a pedestrian.

claims.claim_text: The duration of each violation is limited to 2 seconds, so if the car remains on the sidewalk for 10 seconds, this will be counted as 5 violations, not one.
claims.normalized_text: Each violation duration is capped at 2 seconds for counting infractions.
